Backend: 9/9 pytest PASS — (1) GET /sessions-list/{plan_id} returns correct {items,total_sessions} shape with meso→micro→sessions tree; (2) invalid plan_id → 404; (3) test account plan (0 microcycles) → items=[], total_sessions=0; (4) POST /generate accepts selected_session_ids absent/empty/populated and always produces valid %PDF (6 pages, 298KB, 4 internal link annotations verified via pypdf); (5) POST /preview accepts selected_session_ids and returns valid PNG; (6) Summary preset (6 core sections) generates >2KB PDF; (7) Source asserts confirm id='sec-{sid}' injection on <section> tags + <a href='#sec-...'> in TOC + ev-block sess-card gradient design. Frontend: login + modal + Contenido tab + mr-section-sessions toggle + mr-summary-btn download all work. Summary button triggers browser download of 'resumen_plan.pdf' successfully. mr-sessions-selector correctly hidden when plan has no sessions (expected per context note for test@train.com).
critical_code_review_comments: master_report.py is now 1530 lines (grew from 1443). Splitting into models/styles/html_builder/sections/routes is long overdue (4th iteration flagging).

buildPayload in MasterReportModal.js line 142: 'selectedSessionIds && selectedSessionIds.length >= 0' is always true for any non-null array — evaluates to array length (truthy for []). The intent (null=all, array=filter) works because null check short-circuits, but the `>= 0` is dead code. Simplify to `selectedSessionIds ?? undefined` or `Array.isArray(selectedSessionIds) ? selectedSessionIds : undefined` for clarity.

Per-session filter loop in sessions section (line 967) discards empty micros after filter — good. But if selected_session_ids has values not matching ANY session in the plan, output becomes an empty sessions section with just the header. Consider emitting a fallback note ('Ninguna sesión coincide con la selección').
_capture_graphic_plan_on_demand still creates graphic_plan_shares docs without TTL/cleanup (5th iteration note).
Sessions exercises truncated silently at [:25] per session — user gets no indication if >25 exercises exist. Add 'Mostrando 25 de N' note.
The injected id='sec-{sid}' uses the internal section key ('diagnostic_active', etc.) which is opaque to end users inspecting the PDF. Fine for anchors but worth documenting.
